armchair.look: a single cozy upholstered ARMCHAIR facing the viewer: a deep padded fabric seat with a tall padded backrest and two soft ARMRESTS, on short wooden feet. A lounge chair.

armchair_fancy.look: a plush WINGBACK ARMCHAIR facing the viewer: a tall padded backrest with winged sides, rolled arms, deep buttoned burgundy upholstery, on small wooden feet.

bar_cart.look: a BAR CART: a small two-tier brass-and-glass rolling cart holding bottles and glasses.

bathtub.look: a clawfoot BATHTUB seen front-on: a white enamel oval tub on four clawed feet, filled with water.

bed_basic.look: a simple BED seen front-on from slightly above: plain wooden frame, a white PILLOW at the head end (top), and a plain blue BLANKET over the mattress. Modest, no tall posts.

bed_canopy.look: a grand CANOPY BED seen front-on from slightly above: four tall posts holding a draped fabric CANOPY overhead, plump white pillows, a rich red quilt. Luxurious.

bed_fancy.look: an ornate four-poster BED seen front-on from slightly above: wooden frame with tall carved CORNER POSTS, a plump white PILLOW at the head end (top), and a richly colored deep-purple QUILT/BLANKET with trim covering the mattress. Clearly a bed.

bench.look: a long wooden BENCH facing the viewer: a horizontal plank seat on legs with a low back rail; wide enough to seat two.

bench_padded.look: a long UPHOLSTERED BENCH facing the viewer: a padded muted fabric top on short wooden legs, no back; seats two or three.

bench_stone.look: a carved STONE BENCH: a long slab seat resting on two stone-block legs.

bookshelf.look: a tall wooden BOOKCASE: an upright wooden frame divided into 3-4 horizontal SHELVES, each shelf packed with a row of upright BOOKS with colorful spines (muted red, green, blue, ochre, brown), a few books tilted at an angle. The shelves-with-books fill the whole front face; clearly a bookshelf, NOT a plain cabinet or dresser.

bookshelf_fancy.look: a tall ornate MAHOGANY BOOKCASE: a dark carved wooden frame with 4 shelves packed with colorful books and a decorative cornice on top. Richer than a plain bookshelf.

bunk_bed.look: a wooden BUNK BED seen front-on: two stacked bunks with a ladder at one end and plain bedding.

cabinet.look: a wooden DISPLAY CABINET seen front-on: a chest-high cabinet with GLASS-front upper doors showing shelves inside, and solid lower doors with knobs.

chair_cushioned.look: a wooden CHAIR facing the viewer with a soft CUSHION: an upright slatted back, four legs, and a padded muted-blue fabric SEAT CUSHION on top.

chair_fancy.look: a comfy upholstered ARMCHAIR facing the viewer: wooden frame with a padded PURPLE cushioned seat, a tall padded backrest and small armrests.

chair_wood.look: a simple wooden CHAIR facing the viewer: a seat, four legs, and an upright BACKREST with vertical slats. Clearly a chair.

chaise_lounge.look: a CHAISE LOUNGE: an elegant backless reclining sofa with one raised curved end and a rolled bolster, richly upholstered.

coffee_table.look: a low rectangular COFFEE TABLE: a long low wooden tabletop on short legs, lower than a dining table, empty surface.

cot.look: a simple narrow COT seen front-on from slightly above: a low plain wooden frame with a thin mattress and a plain grey blanket, no posts. Modest and small.

counter.look: a kitchen COUNTER cabinet seen front-on: a wooden base CABINET with two cupboard doors and knobs below, and a flat pale stone COUNTERTOP across the top, empty surface. A section of kitchen counter.

counter_fancy.look: a kitchen COUNTER with a MARBLE top seen front-on: a wooden base cabinet with doors and knobs below, and a pale veined MARBLE countertop across the top, empty surface.

cupboard.look: a kitchen CUPBOARD seen front-on: a tall wooden cabinet with two panelled doors and knobs, for storing dishes. Clearly a cupboard.

desk.look: a wooden WRITING DESK facing the viewer: a flat top with a stack of small DRAWERS (knobs) under one side and slim legs. Clearly a desk.

dining_table_fancy.look: an ornate carved DINING TABLE: a large polished wooden tabletop with decoratively turned/carved legs, richer than a plain table, empty surface.

dresser.look: a wooden DRESSER / chest of drawers seen front-on: a low wide cabinet with three stacked DRAWERS, each with two round knobs, short feet. Clearly a dresser, NOT a bookshelf or cabinet of doors.

dresser_fancy.look: a carved hardwood DRESSER / chest of drawers seen front-on: a low wide cabinet with three drawers, ornate brass handles and carved trim, short curved feet.

fridge.look: a wide squat retro REFRIGERATOR seen front-on: a rounded-corner cream/white enamel cabinet, a horizontal seam splitting it into a smaller top FREEZER door and a larger lower door, a slim vertical chrome HANDLE on each door. Clearly a kitchen appliance, NOT a cabinet, wardrobe or dresser. Wider than it is tall.

grandfather_clock.look: a tall GRANDFATHER CLOCK seen front-on: a narrow upright wooden cabinet with a round white CLOCK FACE near the top and a long glass PENDULUM case below. Much taller than wide.

keg.look: a wooden brewing KEG/cask standing upright: a fat vertical wooden barrel bound with dark metal HOOPS, with a small metal TAP/spigot near the bottom front. Clearly a keg for brewing, taller and chunkier than a plain barrel.

kitchen_island.look: a kitchen ISLAND: a free-standing counter block with a pale butcher-block top and cabinet doors around the base.

loveseat.look: a small two-seat SOFA (loveseat) facing the viewer: a short padded couch with two seat cushions, a padded back and rolled arms, cosy warm fabric. Narrower than a full sofa.

nightstand.look: a small wooden BEDSIDE TABLE / nightstand seen front-on: a little cabinet with one small DRAWER (a round knob) above a tiny open shelf, short legs, flat top. Small.

nightstand_fancy.look: an ornate BEDSIDE NIGHTSTAND seen front-on: a small elegant cabinet with one drawer (brass handle) and curved carved legs. Refined.

ottoman.look: a padded round OTTOMAN footstool: a low upholstered cushion-stool with a tufted top, short feet.

planter_box.look: a low rectangular wooden PLANTER BOX/trough filled with green leafy plants and a few small flowers poking up above the rim.

range_stove.look: a large kitchen RANGE seen front-on: a wide steel-and-enamel cooking range with a big oven door (handle + window) below and a flat cooktop on top showing FOUR round black burners. Bigger than a basic stove.

rocking_chair.look: a wooden ROCKING CHAIR facing the viewer: a tall slatted back, armrests, and curved ROCKER runners instead of straight feet at the bottom. Cosy.

sawhorse.look: a carpenter's SAWHORSE: an open A-frame wooden trestle - a horizontal top beam with splayed angled legs forming an A at each end; you can see through the open frame.

side_table.look: a small round SIDE TABLE: a little round wooden tabletop on a single slim pedestal or three thin legs. Small, empty top.

sink.look: a kitchen SINK unit seen front-on: a counter-height base cabinet with a rectangular metal BASIN set into the top and a curved chrome FAUCET/tap rising at the back. Clearly a sink, NOT a plain cabinet.

sofa.look: a comfy upholstered SOFA/couch facing the viewer: a long padded fabric couch with two seat cushions, a padded backrest, and rolled ARMRESTS at each end, in a warm muted fabric color. Wide enough to seat two or three. Clearly a sofa, NOT a bench or bed.

sofa_fancy.look: a luxurious VELVET SOFA facing the viewer: a long padded couch with deep tufted cushions, rolled arms, rich purple velvet, small carved wooden feet.

stool_stone.look: a simple STONE STOOL: a short cylindrical carved-stone seat, no back.

stool_wood.look: a small round wooden STOOL: a round flat seat on three or four splayed legs, no backrest. Low and simple.

stove.look: a kitchen STOVE / oven RANGE seen front-on: an enamel-and-steel cabinet with an OVEN door (a handle and a small dark window) below, and a flat COOKTOP across the top showing TWO round black BURNERS. A two-burner cooking range, clearly a stove.

stove_wood.look: a cast-iron WOOD-BURNING STOVE seen front-on: a chunky black iron stove body with a small door showing glowing orange FLAMES, short legs, and a stovepipe rising from the top.

table_stone.look: a STONE TABLE: a flat grey stone slab tabletop on a chunky stone pedestal/legs, empty surface.

table_wood.look: a sturdy rectangular wooden TABLE: a flat plank tabletop on four legs, wood grain running across the top, empty surface.

throne.look: an ornate golden THRONE: a tall high-backed gilded chair with deep-red velvet cushions and carved arms; opulent.

vanity.look: a VANITY dressing table: a slim wooden table with a tall oval MIRROR above it and a small drawer, a little stool tucked under.

wardrobe.look: a tall WARDROBE / armoire seen front-on: a tall narrow wooden cabinet with two full-height panelled doors, knobs and a small cornice on top. Taller than it is wide.

wine_rack.look: a wooden WINE RACK: a small lattice/X-frame of diamond cubbies holding several wine BOTTLES lying on their sides (green and red glass).

specimen_shelf.look: a wooden SHELF unit lined with glass SPECIMEN JARS holding preserved bugs and leaves, seen front-on; a naturalist's display

bug_terrarium_big.look: a large glass BUG TERRARIUM tank on a wooden stand, green plants and a branch inside, seen front-on; a vivarium display

map_table_big.look: a large wooden MAP TABLE strewn with rolled charts and an open land MAP, seen front-on; a planning table

sofa_modern.look: a clean low-line MODERN SOFA with square cushions, neutral grey upholstery, seen front-on; minimalist couch

shop_shelving.look: tall wooden STORE SHELVING seen front-on: an upright frame of 3-4 horizontal SHELVES stocked with assorted general-store SUNDRIES - jars, sacks, bottles, folded cloth and tins in muted colors; a stocked shop shelf, NOT books, NOT a plain cabinet
